en.text:
Kills or 2 Direct Hits within ? seconds of each other spawn a seeking Hive Moth.

Hive Moths deal <pve 525 /> <pvp [31] /> damage with a blast radius of 7 meters and <arc/>Blind for 10 seconds.

Wearing <yellow Mothkeeper's Wraps /> spawns an additional Hive Moth that grants 22.5 HP <void/>Void Overshield to the nearest ally. 

3 second cooldown between activations.
